content:
Braze is one of the best Customer Engagement Platforms (CEP). It helps businesses gather real-time customer data, automate cross-channel customer journeys, and deliver personalised experiences. The platform is primarily designed for enterprise organisations especially those who need instant, behaviour-driven engagement. 

In fact, Braze uses a real-time streaming architecture. It consistently processes customer interactions as they occur. Eventually, it unifies customer data management, omnichannel marketing and an AI-powered organisation. Braze also helps brands to engage with customers at scale.

How does Braze work?

Braze gathers customer interactions from different touchpoints. It can include websites, mobile apps, CRM systems and other platforms. All the data is then fed into a live customer profile. In turn, it starts custom communication through various mediums. Some important parts of this process include:

  •  Customer Data Management- Braze gathers customer information from multiple sources. It is laid out in a single profile. This helps businesses get a full overview of every customer. 
  • Real-Time Journey automation- It automatically delivers personalised experiences. 
  • Omnichannel Messaging- The platform enables constant customer communication. It can be email, SMS, mobile app or other means. 
  • AI-powered Optimisation- Braze uses AI to understand customer patterns and forecast outcomes. In turn, it suggests the right channel and content for them.

Core Capabilities

Real-Time Data Streaming

Braze processes customer interactions immediately. It helps in quick engagement and personalisation.

Customer Profile Management

It unifies customer profiles. This is made using behavioural, purchase and demographic data. 

Dynamic Segmentation

The platform automatically updates audience segments. They use real-time customer data for this purpose.

Omnichannel Messaging

Braze supports email, SMS, mobile push, web push, WhatsApp, and in-app messaging. 

Journey Orchestration

It enables marketers to design and automate complex customer journeys. The platform has a special Braze Canvas for this purpose. 

What makes Braze different?

  • Gathers authentic, real-time data: Braze gathers true real-time customer engagement data. In turn, it is organised through streaming data architecture. 
  • Mobile-first feature- It has a mobile-first base. This is specifically made to give optimal modern digital experiences. 
  • Flexible integration- The platform easily integrates with data warehouses, CDPs, and enterprise ecosystems.
  • Braze Canvas- Braze has a special Braze Canvas that helps to automate the advanced cross-journey of users. 
  • Enterprise-grade personalisation- The platform enables businesses to personalise the customer at a large scale. It uses customer data and AI.

Key Services

  • Customer Engagement Platform: Braze enables centralised customer engagement across different digital channels. 
  • Omnichannel Messaging- It supports Email, SMS, WhatsApp, push notifications and more. 
  • Braze Canvas- Braze Canvas is the platform's visual journey builder. It makes custom customer lifecycle campaigns.
  • Customer Data Integrations - They directly help integrate with CDPs, CRM platforms, and cloud data warehouses.

Advanced Capabilities

  • Predictive Churn Modelling- It finds at-risk customers before disengagement. 
  • Connected Content- The platform takes live data from external APIs at the exact moment of message delivery. 
  • Zero-Copy Data Architecture- Braze activates customer data directly from external warehouses. In turn, there is no duplication.
  • Feature Flag Management- It enables product teams to manage application experiences for specific customer categories.

Who should work with Braze?

  • Enterprise organisations that manage large customer bases on multiple channels.
  • Growth and Lifecycle Marketing Teams aim to create better customer journeys and lifecycle campaigns. 
  • Product and Engineering Teams working on mobile apps or digital products. 
  • Data and Analytics teams that manage modern data ecosystems

Best- Fit Industries

  • E-commerce 
  • Travel and Hospitality 
  • Fintech 
  • Mobile Apps 
  • Entertainment

Key Use Cases

  • Customer Onboarding - Braze helps new users set up and activate their accounts. 
  • Cart Abandonment Recovery: It re-engages shoppers who added products to their carts. But did not buy it.
  • Real-Time Transactional Messaging- The platform sends immediate delivery updates, payment confirmations, and service alerts, etc. 
  • Churn Prevention Campaigns- Braze finds and engages customers who might be at risk of leaving.

Pros

  • Best real-time engagement
  • Strong mobile-first architecture
  • Advanced customer journey automation 
  • Flexible integration with modern data infrastructure

Considerations

  • Premium pricing 
  • Requires technical resources to implement and maintain 
  • Difficult to Setup

Top Alternatives to Consider

  • MarketJoy- Specializes in multi-channel B2B lead generation services
  • Iterable- Expert customer engagement platform
  • MoEngage- Gives the best mobile-first customer engagement 
  • Klaviyo- Impressive platform for e-commerce and DTC brands 
  • Customer.io- Best-in-class event-driven messaging platform 

Conclusion

Braze is one of the best customer engagement platforms in the market. It is primarily designed for companies that want real-time personalisation across multiple channels. At the same time, it works on large-scale customer journey automation. 

 Do you want to make real-time customer experiences and improve engagement on multiple platforms? Braze can improve your retention, loyalty, and drive long-term growth.
